_what: THE LADDER AS A GRAPH. Paolo 8/13 approved the prerequisite column ('Sure'). These are the PHYSICALLY NECESSARY edges only: an edge exists when node B's LOCK cannot be opened without node A's GRANT, and the reason must be statable in one sentence from the two rows' own text. Nothing here is a pacing edge, a taste edge, or a difficulty edge. Physics and canon only.
_why_reasons_are_required: An edge without a reason is me deciding how his game is played and hiding it in a data file. Every edge is auditable against the ladder rows, and ladder_graph_gate.js fails on any edge whose reason is missing or too short to be an argument.
_what_is_NOT_here: QUEST GATES. Physical necessity alone leaves 20 nodes with no prerequisite, so act 1 opens with 20 doors and he ruled the live menu should be 4 to 6. Closing that gap needs non-physical gates, and R-GATE names them: quests. Which node sits behind which quest is CONTENT and it is his. The quest_gates object below is deliberately EMPTY.

edges.why: a forge that still lights cannot light without fire
you cannot weld pipe, cap and nail together without heat
a press frame and its type are machine-shop work before they are printing
every roof worth catching rain off is above the ground floor, and before THE CLIMB everything up there is scenery
you cannot operate on a body you cannot yet treat and dose
a birth that goes wrong is a wound, and an untreatable wound is a death
you do not open a pit by hand; it takes something that goes off
the workshop is the first thing you own that keeps working while you are not there, which is the whole idea of a crew
GDD v5 says water is not the binding constraint, soil and LABOR are, so farming the fairways is a labour unlock
you cannot save seed before there is a crop to save it from
a compressor does not run without power on the block
THE COLD's own row names culture as a thing only it can hold, and a bioreactor at volume is culture
you cannot pressurise a main that has nothing in it
his own lore ruling: act 1 pyrolysis is crude and low-yield, and mass production waits on the catalyst
concrete is aggregate, and aggregate comes out of the pit
flat glass is melted sand
a barrier is material before it is a position
the ladder already pairs them: a cleared route stays open only if it is held
a car cannot cross a map cut into pieces nothing can drive between
nothing drives without fuel, and fuel cannot be replaced once it is siphoned
freight at scale is the vehicle problem solved a second time, bigger
you do not restore a dam without a working batch plant
one person standing there does not bring 2GW back
you cannot distribute power you are still rationing
an elevator that loses power is a shaft
an assembly line is a power draw before it is a process
a circuit is precisely the thing you must make many of, identically
you cannot build UP without concrete
a tower nobody can get up is not a building
the Strip is a district, and lighting it is distribution
a floor that takes a bet needs somebody standing at it
the ladder already says a theatre that can operate is what makes an implant thinkable
chrome is electronics before it is surgery
an antenna reaching something bigger is a radio you had to fabricate
a transmitter that size is a load, not a battery job
an airframe burns fuel and there is no other source of it
a debt you cannot produce in writing is a rumour
teaching past your own voice needs something that outlives the telling

routes._what: R-ACQUIRED: 'I dont know if its all gonna be just bosses... the idea is that its something thats ACQUIRED so it doesnt have to maybe not killing or persuading a particular person like its just a quest.' So each node declares HOW it is acquired.

_types.BOSS: a person holds it; you best them by killing or by sparing
_types.QUEST: a job with no antagonist; nobody to fight, nobody to persuade
_types.FOUND: you come across it and it is yours
